sections.text: مقدمة

This document outline the
equipment inspection checklist I1 which must be performed every two years as 
indicated by Y2 in the title block .

The Condensate exits the
atmospheric blow down tank through 3 way V/V where it
normally routed through the blow down heat exchanger on its way to the flow blow
down sump.

The blow down heat exchanger is a
single pass tube and shell type exchanger using service water as a cooling
medium on the tube side.
The blow down sump contains two vertically mounted submerged P/Ps which discharge to the waste treatment system.

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

تم تنقيح هذه الوثيقة بواسطة المهندس. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

Inspect for corrosion 
visually or by dye-penetrant, especially around
connections under insulation clean and repaint by Alomineed (thermal paint).

Check for abnormal noise to know baffle
condition and readjust the steam flow and cooling water and weld any cracks.

Check steam flow rate to know if there is
tube leak or not
Check steam trap condition
Retighten cover bolts if there is leakage
